decision_reason: This is the source repository for the Portuguese Open Government Partnership portal, not merely a government-use reference: the official portal says the site was created for Portugal's OGP participation and that its source is open on GitHub; AMA's accessibility statement identifies the live site as AMA's. Current official portal documentation lists the 2024–27 action plan and 2026 network activity. The repository is a Liferay portal codebase with a full EUPL-1.2 grant. Although its source history is quiet since 2020, the current official portal continues to distribute the source and operate the named service, satisfying the maintained-source exception. No exact GOSDIR catalog match found; no catalog entry added.

government_provenance.note: The official OGP Portugal portal says this portal was created within Portugal's OGP participation and is available open source on GitHub; AMA's accessibility declaration identifies the exact live Open Government Partnership Portugal website as AMA's (https://ogp.digital.gov.pt/acessibilidade). The assigned repository is the matching OGP Portugal portal source, rather than evidence of a government merely using third-party software.

public_source.note: The public canonical repository contains the Liferay Gradle workspace, deployment configurations, modules and WARs for the OGP Portugal portal; source is accessible without credentials.

eligible_license.note: The root file is the full EUPL-1.2 grant, an OSI-approved license, covering this repository's first-party portal source and documentation. External Liferay and other dependencies retain their own terms.

primary_evidence.note: The official, operating OGP portal publishes Portugal's 2024–27 national action plan and documents multistakeholder meetings through June 2026; the same current portal states its source is available on GitHub. This is a named government service with current product-specific operation and user-facing content, not a bare repository or stale citation.

decision_reason: The AMA-authored public repository is an API-specification, documentation, JSON-example and small static-widget bundle for Single Digital Gateway statistics/feedback integration, not the canonical implementation of a deployable service or API backend. The current official SDG page describes the Portuguese portal but does not identify this repository as a current implementation; the repository has no releases and its last code changes are from 2020. Reject as a standalone notable software product, while preserving the passing provenance, public-source and scope-limited license findings below. No catalog entry added.

government_provenance.note: The exact repository history shows the AMA engineer account dsiama committing the API examples/specification under an @ama.pt address; the commit is for the specific SDG integration bundle. This supports AMA authorship of these artifacts, not government use of an unrelated third-party platform.

public_source.note: The canonical public repository exposes OpenAPI specifications, SDG statistical/feedback JSON examples, explanatory documentation, and HTML survey widgets. It does not contain a deployable implementation of the APIs/backend.

eligible_license.note: The repository has a full EUPL-1.2 root grant, an OSI-approved license, for first-party specifications, examples and widgets. Bundled Jekyll theme/documentation components and their dependencies retain any separate upstream terms; this grant does not establish licensing of an absent API service.

primary_evidence.note: The current official Mosaico page documents Portugal's Single Digital Gateway, but not this repository as its source or a currently deployed tool. A named topic and live government portal do not make this bundle notable software under the baseline.

Government adoption is not government provenance; reject from this government-origin catalog on that decisive failure while retaining the independently verified source, EUPL grant, use and product evidence. No catalog entry added.
